# `context.get`

Return a bounded VoiceContextBundle/v1 for an OPERATOR subject. Never raw samples by default.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice context-get`
- **MCP tool:** `context_get`

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | `str` | optional, default=None | Opaque subj_* id; defaults only when exactly one active OPERATOR subject exists |
| `consumer_id` | `str` | required | Required agent/tool name used for audit provenance |
| `channel` | `str` | optional, default='general' |  |
| `audience` | `str` | optional, default='general' |  |
| `purpose` | `str` | optional, default='general' |  |
| `language` | `str` | optional, default='en' |  |
| `output_type` | `str` | optional, default='text' |  |
| `token_budget` | `int` | optional, default=800 | Estimated token limit for the whole compact JSON payload; whole number from 200 to 999999999999 |
| `accepted_major_versions` | `json` | optional, default=None | JSON list of bundle majors the consumer accepts (e.g. ["v1"]); negotiation fails closed if none match |

## Examples

```
operator-voice context-get --consumer-id demo-cli
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `unknown_subject` | No registered subject has that id — nothing changed. |
| `no_operator_subject` | No operator subject is registered; run setup to register one before requesting context. |
| `inactive_operator_subject` | Operator subjects exist but are paused; list subjects and pass one opaque id explicitly. |
| `ambiguous_operator_subject` | More than one active operator subject exists; pass one listed opaque subject id explicitly. |
| `operator_only` | This serves your own (OPERATOR) subject; use subject.insights for someone else. |
| `no_accepted_bundle_version` | The consumer accepted no context version the toolkit offers, so it declines rather than send an unsupported shape. |
| `insufficient_evidence` | Below the quality floor the toolkit abstains rather than return a thin, misleading bundle. |

- "write this in my voice"
